query: Stress-test this pull request for correctness, security issues, design flaws, and missing tests without changing code.
Before merge, I want an adversarial read-only assessment of the current branch and any concrete risks.
Look across historical code-review outcomes and tell me whether our review dimensions and thresholds are actually useful.
Use past review evidence to propose improvements to AI-assisted review routing and policy, but don't change the policy.
Work out how this repository change should be implemented, including tests, migration, rollout and rollback, but do not edit anything.
I need an executable handoff for another engineer to make this change; inspect the repo and sequence the work first.
Help me build a mental model of how authentication requests move through this codebase and where the main boundaries are.
I'm onboarding to this service. Explain how the subsystem works from entry point through data flow and integrations.
Our long-running project state is fragmented across trackers and docs. Establish a durable agent-readable source of current truth, intent and history.
Agents keep reconstructing project state from chat every session; design a durable context record with provenance and authority.
Model the important domain concepts and relationships in this repository so agents share a grounded vocabulary.
Should this codebase have a lightweight ontology or knowledge graph, and what concepts should it contain?
We're resuming work from an earlier session. Check whether the current proposal conflicts with prior accepted or rejected decisions.
Before continuing this handoff, reconstruct the governing intent and make sure we're not silently reopening a previously rejected option.
A test is flaky under load and we don't know why. Reproduce it, minimise the failure and test competing root-cause hypotheses before proposing a fix.
This performance regression has several plausible causes. I want causal evidence, not a speculative patch.
The docs are unclear about this library's concurrency semantics. Build a tiny isolated experiment to establish the actual runtime behaviour.
We have an uncertain compatibility claim that can only be settled by running a bounded reproducible technical experiment.
Assess whether this repository is actually safe for coding agents to operate autonomously and what autonomy level the evidence supports.
Why are agent-generated changes unreliable in this repo, and what repository capabilities are missing before we increase autonomy?
Design a resumable multi-step agent state machine where code owns retries, policy and effects and models are bounded decision points.
Build an executable Mastra workflow with ACP coding workers, fan-out and fan-in, and a bounded loop.
Instrument model calls, tool calls, handoffs, retries and costs so an agent run can be reconstructed from correlated traces.
Use code to coordinate a batch of tool calls with filtering, loops and aggregation so the model doesn't have to round-trip for every result.
This implementation has a demanding acceptance contract. Use independent producers and adversarial critics in bounded loops until the evidence passes.
Persist this durable shared project decision into our Confluence memory area with provenance so future sessions can recover it.
What does our shared project memory say about the database migration decision from earlier sessions? Retrieve only what matters for this task.
Audit the shared Confluence memory for duplicates, stale entries, contradictions and weak provenance, proposing repairs.
We're done for today. Capture the material friction, corrections and discoveries from this one session for later analysis.
Look across the last several agent sessions and identify recurring friction or patterns that may deserve durable codification.
Analyse my actual AI-session prompts and show me how I could frame, steer and verify model work more effectively.
Use my accessible conversation history to do a candid longitudinal self-audit of recurring patterns, contradictions and blind spots.
I know almost nothing about CRDTs. Give me the quick adult-friendly gist without turning it into a course.
Teach me Rust ownership properly, quiz me, give feedback and help me retain it for an interview.
Rewrite this ADR so it is concise, direct, natural and less AI-sounding without losing technical precision.
Create a standalone architecture visual showing the request path, failure paths and fallback behaviour.
Discover the coding conventions this repository actually follows and which recurring review comments could be enforced deterministically.
Prepare a large-scale modernization of this legacy service to a new runtime, with a pilot, correctness certificate and promotion policy.
Create a durable repository capability that tells coding agents how to launch the real product, drive behaviour, capture evidence and clean up.
Fine-tune and evaluate a small task-specific model under explicit latency, memory and quality constraints, then package the best Pareto option.
Open a pull request from my current branch with a grounded description of the complete committed change; don't merge it.
The rebase is blocked by conflicts where both sides changed behaviour. Reconstruct the intent and resolve the semantic integration safely.
Who are the likely current reviewers and subsystem stewards based on repository contribution history and knowledge coverage?
Use git history to find change hotspots and recurring fix-associated paths that should guide where I investigate this unfamiliar repo first.
Correlate recent PR, CI, incident and commitment signals and tell me what engineering work needs attention now.
Reconstruct evidence of my engineering and business impact this quarter for a leadership update, distinguishing activity from observed impact.
Compare this external repository's approach with our current system and recommend a few high-value mechanisms worth adapting rather than copying wholesale.
Combine conflicting internal docs and records with source precedence and external frameworks into a defensible decision brief.
Detect the languages in this repo and refresh the Copilot CLI LSP wiring and VS Code extension recommendations.
Create a reusable Agent Skill for this repeated workflow and set up paired evaluations so we can improve its triggering and performance.
